text: Our visual style for Instagram prioritizes versatility in lighting, from soft, diffused natural light for architectural and lifestyle shots to dramatic, focused illumination creating chiaroscuro effects for portraits and events, while product hero shots utilize clean, even studio lighting. The colour palette is anchored in sophisticated neutrals, rich wood tones, and subtle greens for environmental shots, frequently contrasted with vibrant, sometimes translucent, product hues that pop against minimalist white or grey backdrops, occasionally employing high-contrast black and white for dynamic scenes. Compositions range from clean, symmetrical product isolation and precise flat lays to wider, architectural interior shots emphasizing curated environments, alongside dynamic mid-to-close-up portraits. Eyewear is presented diversely: worn by individuals in compelling, narrative-driven scenarios, isolated as hero products against pristine backgrounds, or elegantly displayed within stylish retail settings and meticulously arranged multi-frame layouts. Retouching ensures natural clarity and sharpness across all assets; product details are rendered with crisp precision and accurate colour, while human subjects maintain authentic texture, often enhanced for dramatic contrast or a clean, aspirational finish. The overall mood balances refined sophistication with contemporary lifestyle appeal, projecting an aspirational, curated, and authentic brand image that encompasses classic elegance, intellectual depth, and inviting warmth.
